rules.statement: A married woman must obtain her husband's written consent to dispose of immovable property acquired before the Amending Ordinance No. 18 of 1923, and if the husband refuses his consent, she can apply to the District Court for an order authorizing the disposal.
rules.supporting_quote: By their marriage while those sections were in force, the husband and wife in this case acquired certain mutual rights. The husband under section 9 acquired a right to restrain his wife from disposing of her immovable property without his own consent. The wife acquired a corresponding right, in the event of her husband refusing bis consent, to apply to the District Court for an order dispensing with that consent; the conditions under which the Court could dispense with that consent being defined in the section.
